a.xlink:title: Convenience umbrella header for the complete public CCSDSPack API.
Defines storage and secondary-header handling for a CCSDS packet data field.
Defines non-throwing result/error types and propagation helpers used by CCSDSPack.
Defines the extension interface and raw-buffer implementation for packet secondary headers.
Defines the host-only parser for CCSDSPack key:type=value configuration files.
Defines standards-oriented PUS-A and PUS-C TC/TM secondary headers.
Defines numeric CCSDS Unsegmented Time Code support.
Defines CCSDS Space Packet primary-header fields, validation, and serialization.
CCSDS 133.0-B-2 Space Packet container, parsing, and packet-level error control.
Declares CRC, diagnostic formatting, and binary file helper functions.
Raw pointer-plus-size adapters for Packet and Manager APIs.
